description: The main source file for the Healthcare Connect Flutter frontend app, including app initialization, main widget setup, environment loading, dependency injection, and routing logic to different dashboards based on user authentication status.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the Flutter application, setting up providers and theming.

classes.name: SplashScreen
classes.description: Displays a splash/loading screen and redirects users based on authentication status.

classes.name: _SplashScreenState
classes.description: State management for SplashScreen, handling initialization and navigation logic.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the Flutter app, initializes environment and runs the root widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for MyApp widget, constructing the widget tree with providers and theme.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state for the splash screen, triggering authentication check.

methods.name: _checkAuth
